core.title: Anodized Aluminum Neoprene Door Sweep, NGP 203NA-48

text.description_html:
NGP 203NA-48, Anodized Aluminum Neoprene Door Sweep

NGP 200NA Anodized Aluminum Neoprene Door Sweep is used to close the bottom gap on a undercut door. This 48 inch long door sweep is made from non rusting T5 aluminum alloy with a Black Neoprene Seal on the bottom. Slotted screw holes for easy height adjustments.

Features and Specifications of the 48" Neoprene Door Sweep:

  • Length: 48"
  • Extrusion Height: 1-1/16"
  • Neoprene Sweep Height: 2"
  • Sweep Material: Neoprene
  • Extrusion Material: Anodized Aluminum
  • Comes packaged with #6 x 1" stainless steel sheet metal screws
  • Neoprene Color: Black
  • Mill Aluminum Finish: Clear Anodized Aluminum
  • Moisture resistant
  • Temperature range -81°F to 275°F
  • Good resistance to ozone, sunlight and aging

Standards of the National Guard Products 200NA:

  • Air Infiltration Tested to ASTM E283, Standard Test Method for Determining Rate of Air Leakage Through Exterior Windows, Curtain Walls, and Doors.
  • ANSI/BHMA Certified. Certified Gasketing complies with American National Standard for Door Gasketing and Edge Sealing Systems ANSI/BHMA A156.22 and is listed in the BHMA Certified Products Directory.

Special Ordered Item. No Returns.
